claims: 11 is the natural number following 10 and preceding 12.
11 is the first two-digit prime number.
The English word "eleven" originates from Old English "endleofan".
Old English "endleofan" means "one left" over after ten.
11 is the base of the undecimal system.
The phrase "Up to eleven" was coined by This Is Spinal Tap to signify going beyond normal limits.
The phrase "Eleventh hour" refers to the last possible moment.
